Website as a service

Your website, built by AI. Cared for by people.

Tell us what you do. Within three days you get a preview of your new website, which we then host, back up and update for you – for a monthly fee.
Nothing to pay today · private preview in 3 working days · cancel online any time
How it works

Four steps and done


01
Tell us what you do
A few minutes into the microphone, or a link to your Facebook or old site. You can also fill in the questionnaire step by step.

02
Start your free trial
Pick a plan and add your card. Nothing is charged today – the card only confirms you are serious, so we can start building for you.

03
AI builds, a person checks
Within 3 working days you get a private preview that only you can see. Tell us what to change and we adjust it.

04
Your site goes live
When the trial ends, your plan starts and we publish the site on your domain. Hosting, backups, security and edits are included.
What you get

Everything a website needs


Hosting and SSL
Fast EU hosting and a secure connection, no hassle.

Daily backups
If something breaks, we roll the site back.

Edits in one sentence
Tell us what to change and see the result in the app.

Visitors in the app
How many people came, from where, and how many called you.

Watched around the clock
If your site goes down, we know before you do.

The domain is yours
We register the domain in your name and the content belongs to you.
The MintyRobot app

Your whole website in your pocket

Website status, visitors and edits in one place. The app speaks your language and works on iPhone, Android and in the browser.
